label: Uneasy calm
summary: A tense, storm-tossed day after Thanksgiving. In Kuwait two Italians were killed by debris as Iranian drones were intercepted; Tehran called the incident suspicious while Washington said Iran still had a chance to make a deal. Fighting in Congo's Ituri province kept UN peacekeepers busy, and a fuel tanker fire in Cairo that killed 31 led to the driver's detention. Storms cut power to more than 900,000 Americans, and a capsized diesel tanker off Ibiza raised fears of a spill. Hackers took down a client platform at AFP, and the UN said maritime trade had stalled. There was some steadier news. Argentina's congress barred the central bank from printing money to fund the state, a Samarkand crisis centre is helping women escape violence, and Harvard researchers showed a compact UV chip for quantum computing. The weighted formula gave 40; no editorial adjustment.
